answer: Accounts whose deposits trace to one funding wallet share a single reward cap. If a treasury tagged sable seeds 1,000 sybils at dawn, together they still earn one cap: payout per identity drops to 1/1,000 while each pays its own 5 POA fee, so the farm loses 4,995 POA net. Funding graphs are clustered on-chain; links found later forfeit excess rewards. Colluders cannot pool, since each needs separate clean capital. The fable of free yield ends; one honest account sees no change.
